name: Sakura MMO 2
source:
Sakura MMO #2 is the direct sequel to Sakura MMO. Viola’s story continues in the magical land of Asaph!

Less than a month prior, Viola was a lawyer bored with her life, who lived in Japan. Her only form of escape was the popular MMO, Asaph Online – but after a shocking turn of events, Viola finds herself transported inside her favorite game!

In Asaph, Viola recruits several cute girls to her party, including the devout maid Neve, the easygoing thief Fion, and the righteous knight Eleri. Together, Viola’s party explore Asaph, taking on quests and defeating monsters.

Though Viola enjoys her days in Asaph, which are filled with fun and excitement, she can’t help but feel that something is missing. Who summoned her to Asaph, and for what reason? Will she ever be able to return to Japan – and does she really want to?

Find out in this exciting sequel full of mysteries, fight scenes, and (most importantly of all) cute girls in skimpy outfits!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/968950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Sakura MMO #2是Sakura MMO的直接续集。维奥拉的故事在亚萨的神奇土地上继续！

不到一个月前，维奥拉还是一名住在日本的律师，对自己的生活感到厌倦。她唯一的逃避方式是流行的MMO 《Asaph Online》——但在发生了令人震惊的事件之后，维奥拉发现自己进入了她最喜欢的游戏中！

在亚萨，薇奥拉招募了几位可爱的女孩加入她的队伍，其中包括虔诚的女仆妮芙、随和的盗贼菲昂和正义的骑士埃莱里。维奥拉一行人一起探索亚萨，接受任务并击败怪物。

虽然维奥拉在亚萨度过了充满乐趣和兴奋的日子，但她不禁觉得缺少了一些东西。谁召唤她到亚萨，出于什么原因？她能回到日本吗？她真的愿意吗？

在这部充满神秘、打斗场景和（最重要的是）穿着暴露服装的可爱女孩的激动人心的续集中找到答案！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/968950/]Steam[/url]]
